name: Red spider-lily
desc: Red spider-lily (Lycoris radiata): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Lycoris radiata, known as the red spider lily, red magic lily, corpse flower, or equinox flower, is a plant in the amaryllis family, Amaryllidaceae, subfamily Amaryllidoideae.
